collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: Since holding a lavastone, a villager sometimes sees things before they happen: use it, or try to make it stop.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Since (subject) held a lavastone during a healing last year, (subject.he/she) has started knowing things before they happen: a pot about to fall, a canoe about to tip. Not always. Not reliably. It frightens (subject.him/her). (friend) thinks it could save lives. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) starts paying attention to the feelings and warning people. Sometimes (subject.he/she) is right. Sometimes (subject.he/she) is wrong. Once, (subject.he/she) warns a fisher not to go out, and a storm comes. Nobody knows if it is the stone or luck. (subject) stops being frightened, mostly.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) asks the healers for help. Rest, calming teas, long swims. The feelings come less often. They do not stop entirely. (subject) learns to live with them, quietly, and tells only (friend).
